actor_id.description: Defaults to the caller. Other actors require server administration.

board_ids.description: Absent/null: unrestricted (refused when the calling credential is board-restricted). [] restricts to no boards.

expires_in_seconds.description: 0 or absent: server default (30 days). Otherwise 60..limits.credential_max_ttl_seconds. Self-issued credentials never outlive the calling credential.
